concerns.text: Booking reference generation relies on second-level Unix timestamp resolution, which could be made more unique with a random suffix.
NotificationReminderService uses an in-memory store suitable for QA test doubles, which will need datastore backing in production.
Webhook endpoints could explicitly document HMAC signature verification headers (e.g. X-Hub-Signature-256) in a future iteration.
Consider adding explicit rate limiting or quota headers to the OpenAPI spec for privacy export and erasure endpoints.
